column1:
Add the Flitt merchants who should receive a portion of each payment. The remainder always stays with your main Merchant ID.

Examples:
• Give a partner 10%: add one receiver with Percentage = 10. Your merchant keeps 90%.
• Platform fee of 5 GEL per order: add one receiver (yourself) with Fixed Amount = 5.
• Two vendors, 60/40 split: add two receivers with Percentage = 60 and 40. Your merchant keeps 0%.
• Mixed: a fixed 2 GEL platform fee + vendor gets 100% of the rest: add receiver 1 (platform) Fixed = 2, receiver 2 (vendor) Percentage = 100.
